profile.description: Electromagnetica S.A. engages in real estate and rental activity in Romania and internationally. The company offers LED lighting solutions, including residential, office, street, emergency, and industrial lighting, as well as projectors; electric car charging stations and power supply equipment for electric vehicles; electrical and electronic equipment, such as electricity intelligent monitoring systems, laboratory, and meters and distribution equipment; and electricity production and supply from renewable resources. It also engages in provision of charging stations for electric cars, metal and plastic subassemblies and equipment for rail traffic safety; and space rental and real estate development. In addition, the company involved in fire prevention, and extinguishing technical assistance activities, as well as provides private emergency services on civil protection, and cleaning services; and rental of offices, call centers, warehouses, sports facility, business park, and land logistics. Electromagnetica S.A. was incorporated in 1930 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania.
